deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 (no spring intake).
deadline.quote: The Fall 2027 application deadline is December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and will not be accepted.
gre_general.quote: General GRE: Not required and will not be accepted

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional; you may submit it if you have it.

also.quote: we do not require the Math subject test but if the scores are available you will have the option to submit as part of your application.

supervisor.value: You do not need to contact faculty before applying; list faculty you would like to work with on the application.
supervisor.quote: Does the Department require applicants to contact faculty before submitting an application? | No, this is not required.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive up to five years of support (fellowships, GSI/GSR) with tuition and fees paid; nonresident tuition stays covered for international students.
funding.quote: all admitted Ph.D. students receive up to five years of financial support through a combination of fellowships, Graduate Student Instructor (GSI) appointments

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; final-year students graduating by mid-August may apply.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. If you are in your final year of studies, and you expect to earn your degree by mid-August of the following year, you may apply.

notes: Biostatistics is a separate PhD (School of Public Health), not covered here.
